_note: Reference catalogue. Every key lives here first; other languages may be partial and fall back to this file.
setup.title: smsledger setup
setup.tagline: Reads the bank notices already on this Mac. No login, nothing uploaded.
access.missing: Could not find the Messages database.
access.missing.why: This tool reads messages already on this Mac, so there is nothing to read.
access.blocked: macOS is blocking access to your messages.
access.blocked.how1: Open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access,
access.blocked.how2: add Terminal (or whichever app you are running this in), then
access.blocked.how3: quit that app completely and run this again.
access.blocked.why: Nothing leaves your Mac either way -- this permission is what lets
access.blocked.why2: the tool read the notices your bank already sent you.
home.default: Your data will be kept in {path}
home.local: (on this Mac only -- nothing is uploaded)
arrivals.recognised: Recognised {count} messages in the last 90 days.
arrivals.unknown: {count} notice(s) look like transactions but are not understood yet:
arrivals.unknown.why1: That means a bank of yours is not supported yet. Everything else
arrivals.unknown.why2: still works; those notices are simply skipped. Sending me the
arrivals.unknown.why3: list above is what gets them added.
arrivals.none.a: - your phone's messages are not forwarded to this Mac
arrivals.none.a2: (on the phone: Settings > Messages > Text Message Forwarding)
arrivals.none.b: - your bank is not supported yet
read.first: The first run goes through everything, so give it a minute.
read.stopped: Stopped. Run python3 -m smsledger setup again when you are ready.
read.failed: Something went wrong above. Nothing was damaged -- run it again,
read.failed2: or python3 -m smsledger doctor to see what it found.
report.bookmark: Bookmark it. It is a plain file -- it works offline and always will.
schedule.what1: A background task can refresh this a few times a day, so the report
schedule.what2: is current whenever you open it. It uses no network and can be removed
schedule.what3: at any time with python3 -m smsledger agent remove.
schedule.skipped: Skipped. Run python3 -m smsledger refresh yourself whenever you want an update.
schedule.blocked.later: Until that is done, run python3 -m smsledger refresh yourself to update.
setup.done: Done. From here on, opening the report is the whole workflow.
agent.installed: Installed. Runs every {hours}h, and once now.
agent.verify: Checking the first run can actually read your messages...
agent.verify.blocked: It ran, but macOS blocked it from reading your messages.
agent.verify.blocked.why: Background tasks need permission separately from the app you
agent.verify.blocked.how1: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access
agent.verify.blocked.how2: press +, then Cmd+Shift+G and paste this exact path:
agent.verify.blocked.how3: turn it on, then run: python3 -m smsledger agent install
agent.verify.timeout: Could not confirm within {seconds}s. Check later with:
agent.removed: Removed. Nothing runs on a schedule any more.
agent.notinstalled: Not installed. python3 -m smsledger agent install to schedule it.
agent.nolog: log:    (nothing yet -- it may not have run)
agent.blocked.short: macOS is blocking the background task from reading your messages.
report.sub: {since} to {until} · {shown} transactions read from {total} parsed notices · no account was logged into to produce this
report.monthly.note: Outflow counts card approvals less cancellations, plus account withdrawals.
report.where.note: Largest outbound counterparties in this window.
report.where.empty: No outbound rows in this window.
report.bal.note: What each account itself stated, as of that message. Not a current balance.
report.caveat.h: What this page cannot tell you
report.caveat.transfers.b: Transfers between your own accounts are counted as outflow.
report.caveat.transfers: Nothing here knows which counterparties are you, so moving money looks like spending. This is the largest distortion above.
report.caveat.left: Balances are as of their last message; anything spent since is missing.
report.caveat.coming: Card charges approved but not yet billed are not projected.
report.caveat.cat: No budgets, no rules, no rollups.
support.readfirst: Open it and read it before sending -- it is plain text.
support.contents: It has versions, permissions and counts. No message text, no amounts, no names.
error.hint: python3 -m smsledger support writes a file you can send to {email}
setup.trouble: If anything goes wrong later, run python3 -m smsledger support -- it writes a file to send to {email}.
support.mail.opened: Draft opened, and the file is showing in Finder -- drag it in to attach.
support.mail.subject: smsledger problem report (v{version})
support.mail.body:
Hello,

Something is not working. Details below, and the diagnostic file is attached.

What I was doing:
  (please describe in a line or two)

What happened instead:
  

---
Please attach this file -- it is showing in Finder now:
{path}

It contains versions, permissions and counts only. No message text, no amounts, no names.
{note}
cli.usage: smsledger -- turn bank and card notices already on this Mac into a report.
cli.doctor: check whether this will work, without changing anything
cli.refresh: read, parse and rebuild, in one go
cli.agent: keep it up to date in the background (install/status/remove)
cli.support: something is wrong -- make a file that can be diagnosed
cli.start: New here? Run: python3 -m smsledger setup
support.file.in1: versions, permission status, row counts, error traces, and the sender
support.file.in2: addresses of messages that have no parser yet.
support.file.out1: no message text, no amounts, no merchants, no account numbers, no names.
support.file.out2: Your username is replaced with ~. Read it before you send it.
summary.title: smsledger summary
summary.corp.h: Excluded from the above (not personal spending)
doctor.title: smsledger doctor
doctor.access.blocked: Messages is not readable -- grant Full Disk Access.
doctor.access.mail.blocked: Apple Mail is not readable -- grant Full Disk Access.
doctor.access.mail.none: No Apple Mail data at {path} -- mail senders will find nothing
doctor.stop: Stopping here: without read access nothing else can be checked.
doctor.sync.none: No incoming messages at all -- is Text Message Forwarding on?
doctor.coverage.none: Nothing matched the senders in your config.
doctor.unknown.h: Money notices with no parser (last {days} days)
doctor.unknown.none: None -- every money-shaped notice has a parser.
doctor.unknown.noise: ({count} one-off match(es) skipped as noise; --min-hits 1 shows them)
doctor.unknown.found: {count} notice(s) from {senders} sender(s) look like transactions but have no parser:
doctor.gaps.nothing: Nothing collected yet -- run python3 -m smsledger collect.
doctor.gaps.behind: {count} message(s) are older than the cursor but were never collected. Phones sync old messages late, and the cursor only moves forward.
doctor.gaps.ok: No messages left behind the cursor.
doctor.mail.truncated: {hit} of {total} mail bodies hit the {limit}-character limit. If a parser is missing amounts, raise mail_body_limit in your config.
doctor.mail.intact: {total} mail bodies, none cut off at {limit} characters
doctor.verdict.unread: Verdict: it works, but {count} transaction notice(s) are going unread.
doctor.verdict.parser: Adding a parser is one file -- see CONTRIBUTING.md.
